tools.name: panda_list_videos
tools.description: List videos. Each video has: id, title, status, created_at, length (seconds), folder_id, config. Results are returned newest first by default. There is NO server-side date filter or sorting — to find videos created on a specific date, fetch videos and check created_at in the response.

tools.name: panda_get_video
tools.description: Get full properties of a video by its ID, including config, profile, status, duration, folder, subtitles, etc.

tools.name: panda_update_video
tools.description: Update basic metadata of a video: title, description text, or move to a different folder. Do NOT use this for player settings, chapters, subtitles, thumbnails, or any playback configuration — use the specific tools for those.

tools.name: panda_delete_videos
tools.description: Delete one or more videos by ID. Sends to trash for 30 days.

tools.name: panda_move_videos
tools.description: Move one or more videos to a folder

tools.name: panda_duplicate_video
tools.description: Create a copy of a video. Only works for CONVERTED, non-external, non-funnel videos.

tools.name: panda_reencode_video
tools.description: Re-encode a video with a specific compression mode

tools.name: panda_upload_video_from_url
tools.description: Import a video from an external URL (YouTube, Vimeo, S3, generic HTTPS)

tools.name: panda_list_folders
tools.description: List all folders. Returns array of {id, name, parent_folder_id, status, created_at, videos_count}.

tools.name: panda_create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder. Returns the created {id, name, parent_folder_id}.

tools.name: panda_get_folder
tools.description: Get a folder's details and contents. Returns {id, name, parent_folder_id, status, videos: [{id, title, status}], folders: [{id, name}]}.

tools.name: panda_update_folder
tools.description: Update folder properties (name, parent). Also used to recover deleted folders with status=true.

tools.name: panda_delete_folder
tools.description: Delete a folder by ID. WARNING: All videos and subfolders inside are also deleted (cascade). Goes to trash for 30 days.

tools.name: panda_list_playlists
tools.description: List all playlists. Returns array of {id, name, videos_quantity, duration, access_type, updated_at}.

tools.name: panda_create_playlist
tools.description: Create a new playlist. Videos are REFERENCES — removing from playlist does NOT delete the video. Returns the created {id, name, description, access_type}.

tools.name: panda_get_playlist
tools.description: Get details of a specific playlist. Returns {id, name, description, videos_quantity, access_type, creator_name, duration, updated_at}.

tools.name: panda_update_playlist
tools.description: Update a playlist's properties

tools.name: panda_delete_playlist
tools.description: Delete a playlist. Videos are NOT deleted — only the collection is removed.

tools.name: panda_get_playlist_videos
tools.description: List all videos in a playlist. Returns array of {id, video_id, order, video: {id, title, duration}}.

tools.name: panda_add_videos_to_playlist
tools.description: Add videos to a playlist with order. Returns the updated playlist video entries [{video_id, playlist_id, order}].

tools.name: panda_remove_video_from_playlist
tools.description: Remove a video from a playlist. Does NOT delete the video.

tools.name: panda_list_profiles
tools.description: List all player profiles (GET /profile). 'Profiles' are player UI configs, not user accounts. Returns {data: [{id, name, pullzone_name}]} — a profile's `name` is the ID of the video it was created for. Use panda_get_profile for a profile's full settings. No pagination.

tools.name: panda_create_profile
tools.description: Create a new player profile (POST /profile). IMPORTANT: per the Panda API, `name` MUST be the ID of an existing video — if it is not a real video ID the API returns 500 and nothing is created. Create only accepts `name` and `exclusive`; it does NOT accept colors/controls/vsl. To set those, call pand

tools.name: panda_get_profile
tools.description: Get details of a specific player profile including all settings (controls, colors, vsl, saveProgress)

tools.name: panda_update_profile
tools.description: Update a player profile's settings. Covers: player colors (colors.primaryColor / controlsColor), enabled controls list, smart autoplay (vsl.smartAutoplay), VSL mode (vsl.disablePause / disableForward / alternativeProgress), playback speed (general.default_speed), save progress, big play button (use

tools.name: panda_delete_profile
tools.description: Delete a player profile by ID

tools.name: panda_apply_profile_to_videos
tools.description: Apply a player profile to one or more videos. Returns confirmation with the list of updated video_ids.

tools.name: panda_list_lives
tools.description: List all live streams. Returns array of {id, title, status, scheduled_at, created_at}.

tools.name: panda_create_live
tools.description: Create a new live stream event

tools.name: panda_get_live
tools.description: Get details of a specific live stream. Returns {id, title, status, scheduled_at, stream_key, rtmp, live_hls, created_at}.

tools.name: panda_finish_live
tools.description: End a live broadcast

tools.name: panda_delete_lives
tools.description: Delete one or more live streams

tools.name: panda_list_stream_keys
tools.description: List all stream keys for live broadcasting. Returns array of {id, name, stream_key, rtmp, created_at}.

tools.name: panda_create_stream_key
tools.description: Create a new named stream key for OBS or other streaming software

tools.name: panda_get_live_viewers
tools.description: Get viewer history for a live stream. Returns time-series array of viewer counts.

tools.name: panda_get_account_analytics
tools.description: Get general analytics metrics for the whole account. Returns {views, unique_viewers, watch_time_seconds, avg_watch_percentage, plays}.

tools.name: panda_get_video_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics metrics for a specific video. Returns {views, unique_viewers, watch_time_seconds, avg_watch_percentage, plays}.

tools.name: panda_get_retention_analytics
tools.description: Get audience retention analytics (account-wide or per video). Returns array of {percentage, viewers} showing drop-off at each point.

tools.name: panda_get_ranking_analytics
tools.description: Get ranking analytics for the account. Returns {most_watched: [{video_id, title, watch_time}], most_played: [{video_id, title, plays}]}.

tools.name: panda_get_realtime_analytics
tools.description: Get real-time viewer count and activity for the account. Returns {current_viewers, active_videos: [{video_id, title, viewers}]}.

tools.name: panda_get_bandwidth_analytics
tools.description: Get bandwidth/traffic usage by folder, by video, or DRM by video. Returns array of {name, bandwidth_bytes, video_id?} entries.

tools.name: panda_list_funnels
tools.description: List all funnels. Returns {data: [{id, name, videos_count, created_at}]}. A funnel with videos_count=0 has no videos. Funnels are NOT folders.

tools.name: panda_create_funnel
tools.description: Create a new video funnel

tools.name: panda_get_funnel
tools.description: Get a funnel's details and its videos. Returns {data: {id, name, videos: [{id, title, status, is_first}]}}. Funnels are NOT folders.

tools.name: panda_update_funnel
tools.description: Update a funnel's properties (rename)

tools.name: panda_delete_funnel
tools.description: Delete a funnel by ID. WARNING: this is destructive. Videos inside the funnel may become inaccessible.

tools.name: panda_add_videos_to_funnel
tools.description: Add one or more videos to a funnel with optional coordinates

tools.name: panda_remove_videos_from_funnel
tools.description: Remove one or more videos from a funnel

tools.name: panda_get_watermark_status
tools.description: Check whether watermark/DRM is currently active on the account. Returns {active: boolean}.

tools.name: panda_enable_watermark
tools.description: Enable watermark protection for the account

tools.name: panda_disable_watermark
tools.description: Disable watermark protection for the account

tools.name: panda_list_watermark_groups
tools.description: List all watermark groups. Returns array of {id, name, active, video_ids: [], folder_ids: [], created_at}.

tools.name: panda_create_watermark_group
tools.description: Create a new watermark group

tools.name: panda_get_watermark_group
tools.description: Get a watermark group's details. Returns {id, name, video_ids: [], folder_ids: [], created_at}.

tools.name: panda_update_watermark_group
tools.description: Update a watermark group

tools.name: panda_delete_watermark_group
tools.description: Delete a watermark group

tools.name: panda_manage_drm_group_items
tools.description: Add or remove videos and/or folders from a DRM watermark group. Returns the updated group with current video_ids and folder_ids.

tools.name: panda_get_thumbnails
tools.description: Get all thumbnails for a video. Returns {start: {url, name}, pause: [{url, name}], end: {url, name}} — each type may be null if not set.

tools.name: panda_add_thumbnail
tools.description: Upload the video cover (start thumbnail) — the image shown before the user presses play. Provide `image_url` pointing to a publicly reachable image (PNG/JPG/WEBP); the tool downloads it and uploads as multipart to the Panda API. Replaces any existing start thumbnail. After this returns, the cover is

tools.name: panda_add_pause_thumbnail
tools.description: Upload a pause thumbnail — an image shown when the viewer pauses the video. Provide `image_url` pointing to a publicly reachable image. Returns the uploaded thumbnail's filename. NOTE: the upload alone is NOT visible in the player — the viewer-facing display requires a pause CTA wiring (with time wi

tools.name: panda_add_end_thumbnail
tools.description: Upload an end thumbnail — an image shown after the video finishes. Provide `image_url` pointing to a publicly reachable image. Returns the uploaded filename. NOTE: the upload alone is NOT visible in the player — the viewer-facing display requires an `end` CTA on the player config that references thi

tools.name: panda_delete_thumbnail
tools.description: Delete a thumbnail from a video. Type: 'start' (default), 'pause' (requires thumb_name), 'end'.

tools.name: panda_get_subtitles
tools.description: Get all subtitle information for a video

tools.name: panda_get_subtitle_by_language
tools.description: Get a subtitle file for a specific language

tools.name: panda_delete_subtitle
tools.description: Remove a subtitle from a video by language

tools.name: panda_generate_ai_subtitles
tools.description: Generate subtitles for a video using Panda AI. Creates a transcription in the specified language. Costs credits based on video duration and tier.

tools.name: panda_update_subtitle_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide a subtitle language (hidden subtitles are not visible but still indexable for search)

tools.name: panda_download_subtitle
tools.description: Download a subtitle file for a specific language

tools.name: panda_get_videos_count
tools.description: Get total video count by status (CONVERTED, CONVERTING, DRAFT, etc.)

tools.name: panda_get_custom_fields
tools.description: Get all custom fields for a video. Returns array of {id, key, value} metadata pairs.

tools.name: panda_create_custom_field
tools.description: Create a custom metadata key-value field for a video (for tagging/categorization). Do NOT use this for chapters, subtitles, CTAs, or player settings — use the specific tools for those. Max 50 fields per video.

tools.name: panda_list_users
tools.description: List all users in the organization. Returns array of {id, name, email, role_id, role_name, created_at}.

tools.name: panda_create_user
tools.description: Create a new user in the organization. Returns the created {id, name, email, role_id}.

tools.name: panda_update_user
tools.description: Update a user's information or role

tools.name: panda_delete_user
tools.description: Remove a user from the organization

tools.name: panda_request_download
tools.description: Request an async download for a video. Only works for CONVERTED, non-external, non-Hotmart videos. Returns {status, message}.

tools.name: panda_check_download_status
tools.description: Check the status of an async download request. Returns {status, download_url} — url is present when status is 'ready'.

tools.name: panda_list_shorts
tools.description: List all Shorts jobs. Projects expire after ~30 days. Returns array of {job_id, status, user_context: {video_title, source_type}, completed_segments, created_at}.

tools.name: panda_import_video_for_shorts
tools.description: Import a video for AI shorts generation. Sources: library (video_id), youtube (source_url). Default config: vertical aspect, 30-60s duration, no captions. Video must be CONVERTED, 5min-5hrs, <50GB, no DRM.

tools.name: panda_list_short_segments
tools.description: List all generated segments (clips) for a Shorts job. Each segment has viralScore, duration, transcription.

tools.name: panda_delete_short
tools.description: Delete a Shorts job/project

tools.name: panda_save_segment_to_library
tools.description: Save a Short segment to the video library as an independent video

tools.name: panda_list_ai_assistants
tools.description: List all AI video assistants. Returns array of {id, name, status, videos: [{id, title}], created_at}.

tools.name: panda_get_ai_assistant
tools.description: Get an AI assistant's details. Returns {id, name, status, videos: [{id, title}], files: [{id, file_name}], answers_count}.

tools.name: panda_create_ai_assistant
tools.description: Purchase credits and create a new AI assistant for a video. Returns the created {id, name, status, video_id}.

tools.name: panda_get_ai_assistant_purchase_overview
tools.description: Get credit cost overview before creating an AI assistant. Returns {credit_cost, current_balance, sufficient_credits}.

tools.name: panda_update_ai_assistant
tools.description: Update AI assistant information (name, status, etc.)

tools.name: panda_update_ai_assistant_video_bindings
tools.description: Replace the videos bound to an AI assistant. Sends the FULL list of video_ids — existing bindings not in the list will be removed.

tools.name: panda_update_ai_assistant_chat_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide the AI chat widget on the video player

tools.name: panda_delete_ai_assistant
tools.description: Delete an AI assistant

tools.name: panda_generate_tutor_file_upload_url
tools.description: Generate a presigned URL to upload a PDF/file to a Tutor AI assistant. Returns upload_url and file_id. After uploading, call panda_confirm_tutor_file_upload.

tools.name: panda_confirm_tutor_file_upload
tools.description: Confirm that a file was successfully uploaded to a Tutor AI assistant (call after uploading to the presigned URL)

tools.name: panda_delete_tutor_file
tools.description: Delete a file from a Tutor AI assistant

tools.name: panda_add_tutor_videos
tools.description: Add videos to a Tutor AI assistant

tools.name: panda_create_ai_dubbing
tools.description: Create an AI dubbing job for a video. Costs 2 credits/min (standard) or 10 credits/min (lipsync). Returns {id, status, video_id, from_lang, to_lang}.

tools.name: panda_delete_dubbing_audio
tools.description: Delete a dubbed audio track from a video

tools.name: panda_get_referrals_summary
tools.description: Get referral program summary (balance, estimated value)

tools.name: panda_get_credits_balance
tools.description: Get the current credits balance for the account. 1 credit = R$1.

tools.name: panda_get_credits_history
tools.description: Get credits transaction history for a date range. Returns {balance, history: [{id, type, amount, status, description, created_at}]}.

tools.name: panda_get_auto_recharge_settings
tools.description: Get auto-recharge configuration for credits. Returns {enabled, trigger_value, action_value}.

tools.name: panda_enable_auto_recharge
tools.description: Enable auto-recharge for credits. When balance drops below trigger, recharges action_value.

tools.name: panda_update_auto_recharge
tools.description: Update auto-recharge settings

tools.name: panda_disable_auto_recharge
tools.description: Disable auto-recharge for credits

tools.name: panda_list_comparisons
tools.description: List all A/B test comparisons. Status: DRAFT → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED. Returns array of {id, name, description, status, videos: [], winner_video_id, created_at}.

tools.name: panda_create_comparison
tools.description: Create a new A/B test. Needs at least 2 videos to start. Returns the created {id, name, status, video_ids}.

tools.name: panda_start_comparison
tools.description: Start an A/B test (begin collecting data). Only from DRAFT status. Returns the updated comparison with status IN_PROGRESS.

tools.name: panda_finish_comparison
tools.description: Finish an A/B test and declare a winner. PERMANENT — cannot be reversed.

tools.name: panda_delete_comparisons
tools.description: Delete one or more A/B tests

tools.name: panda_get_player_config
tools.description: Get global player configuration (applies to all videos without a custom profile)

tools.name: panda_update_player_config
tools.description: Update global player configuration (applies to all videos without a custom profile). Returns the updated config object.

tools.name: panda_get_video_player_config
tools.description: Get per-video player configuration (chapters, CTAs, pixels, redirect, AI features, retention markers, subtitle default, offline config)

tools.name: panda_update_video_config
tools.description:
Update per-video config (POST /player?type=video). Send only fields you want to change.
Fields: chapters, default_subtitle, redirect_video_id, custom_pixels, on_funnel, panda_branding, questions (AI quiz), mindmap (AI), abstract (AI ebook), retention_markers, ai.
NOT for: controls, autoplay, Smart A

tools.name: panda_set_video_offline
tools.description: Configure offline playback for a video (mobile app feature)

tools.name: panda_add_cta
tools.description: Add a CTA (Call-to-Action) button to a video. Placement 'inside' = overlay on the video, 'outside' = below the video. Builds the same payload the dashboard's button editor sends.

tools.name: panda_update_cta
tools.description: Update a CTA on a video. Only the fields you pass are changed; everything else keeps its current value. Placement cannot be changed — delete and re-add the CTA instead.

tools.name: panda_delete_cta
tools.description: Delete a CTA from a video

tools.name: panda_get_ai_workflows
tools.description: Get AI workflow status for a video (transcription, dubbing, translation progress)

tools.name: panda_delete_ai_workflow
tools.description: Delete an AI workflow (transcription, dubbing, etc.)

tools.name: panda_get_subscription
tools.description: Get current subscription/plan details. Returns {subscription_id, subscriptions: {name, status, active}, currency, addons}.

tools.name: panda_list_invoices
tools.description: List all invoices. Returns array of {id, status, amount_due, amount_paid, created, due_date, invoice_pdf, hosted_invoice_url}.

tools.name: panda_list_plans
tools.description: List available subscription plans and pricing

tools.name: panda_list_subaccounts
tools.description: List all subaccounts and their usage limits. Returns array of {organization_id, name, status, credits_balance, storage_used, limits}.

tools.name: panda_update_subaccount
tools.description: Update a subaccount's settings (name, limits, status)

tools.name: panda_delete_subaccount
tools.description: Delete a subaccount

tools.name: panda_transfer_credits
tools.description: Transfer credits to a subaccount

tools.name: panda_help_search
tools.description:
Search Panda Video help center articles to answer user questions.
Searches through ALL 136 pre-indexed articles from the official help center (https://help.pandavideo.com/pt-br/).
Use this tool whenever the user has a QUESTION about how Panda Video works, pricing, features, integrations, configurati

tools.name: panda_help_get_article
tools.description:
Get the full content of a specific Panda Video help center article by slug.
Use this after searching to read the complete content of an article.
The response is the full official documentation.

tools.name: panda_get_business_rules
tools.description:
Returns the platform business rules: the real consequences of actions that modify, delete or move resources (e.g., removing a video from a funnel deletes it permanently, it does not just unlink it).
Useful before planning such actions, so the advice given to the user matches how the platform actuall

tools.name: panda_list_refer
tools.description: List the library-level domain referrers (Domain Protection / allow-block list for playback). Returns { refers: [{ id, url, type, status }] } where type is ALLOW|BLOCK and status is one of active|inactive|pending|deleting|turning_inactive. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

tools.name: panda_list_refer_all
tools.description: List all of the library's domains consolidated by hostname across library and folder scopes. Returns { refers: [{ hostname, type, status, scope, library_refer_id, folders, type_inconsistency, created_at }] }. scope is library|folder|mixed; status may be 'mixed' when rows differ; library_refer_id is

tools.name: panda_list_folder_refer
tools.description: List the domain referrers set directly on a folder. Returns { refers: [{ id, url, type, status, origin: { type, id } }] }. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

tools.name: panda_list_folder_refer_inherited
tools.description: List the effective referrers that apply to a folder using override-total semantics: the folder's own referrers if it has any, otherwise the library-level referrers. Use this to know which domains actually gate playback for videos in the folder. Returns { refers: [{ id, url, type, status, origin: { t

tools.name: panda_create_refer
tools.description: Add one or more library-level domain referrers. Each entry has a hostname and a type (ALLOW|BLOCK, default ALLOW). The same hostname cannot coexist as both ALLOW and BLOCK at the library scope (duplicate check is type-agnostic). New rows start in 'pending' (when domain protection is active) or 'inac

tools.name: panda_create_folder_refer
tools.description: Add a domain referrer scoped to a single folder. type is ALLOW|BLOCK. The new row starts in 'pending'. A folder cannot have the same hostname twice. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted. On error the API returns { errCode, errMsg }.

tools.name: panda_set_refer_status
tools.description: Activate (active=true) or deactivate (active=false) a single referrer by refer_id. Activation moves inactive→pending; deactivation moves active→turning_inactive (the async worker finalizes the state). If the referrer is already in an intermediate state (pending|deleting|turning_inactive) the API ret

tools.name: panda_delete_refer
tools.description: Delete one or more library-level referrers by id (batch). Each referrer must be library-level (folder_id=null) and belong to the library; otherwise the API returns 400 ({ errCode, errMsg }). Rows transition to 'deleting' and are removed asynchronously.

tools.name: panda_delete_folder_refer
tools.description: Delete one or more folder-level referrers by id (batch). Duplicate ids are de-duplicated; if any id is missing the API returns 404, and if any referrer is library-level it returns 400 ({ errCode, errMsg }). Rows transition to 'deleting' and are removed asynchronously.

tools.name: panda_update_folder_refer
tools.description: Edit one or more existing referrers (refer_ids) in a single call: rename the hostname, change the type (ALLOW|BLOCK), and/or move them between scopes. scope='library' makes the domain apply to the whole library (omit folder_ids). scope='folder' makes it apply to the listed folder_ids (required and n

tools.name: panda_set_block_none_refer
tools.description: Set the global 'block_none_refer' policy for the library. When true, playback requests that carry NO referer are blocked; when false, they are allowed. This is the master switch that activates/deactivates domain protection for requests without a referer. On error the API returns { errCode, errMsg }.

tools.name: panda_action_move_videos_by_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a source and target folder and move every video from the source into the target in one call. Pass target_folder_ref='root' to move to the root (no folder). Skips videos already being deleted. Free action (no credits). dry_run=true (default) returns a preview of which videos

tools.name: panda_action_delete_folder_videos
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and send every video inside it to the trash (30-day recovery). DESTRUCTIVE. dry_run=true (default) returns a preview of what would be deleted; set dry_run=false AND confirm=true to actually delete.

tools.name: panda_action_reencode_folder_videos
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and re-encode every CONVERTED video with a given compression mode. Reprocessing consumes processing resources. dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos.

tools.name: panda_action_duplicate_folder_videos
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and create a copy of every CONVERTED video inside it. Duplication only works for non-external, non-funnel videos (the API rejects others, surfaced per-video). dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos.

tools.name: panda_action_set_folder_videos_offline
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and enable or disable offline (mobile app) playback for every CONVERTED video inside it, in one batch call (POST /app). dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos.

tools.name: panda_action_rename_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder by name/ID/URL and rename it (PUT /folders/{id}). dry_run=true (default) previews the rename.

tools.name: panda_action_create_folder_path
tools.description: Deterministically ensure a nested folder path exists (e.g. 'Courses/2026/Module 1'), creating only the missing segments and returning the leaf folder ID. Idempotent: existing segments are reused. dry_run=true (default) previews which segments would be created.

tools.name: panda_action_create_playlist_from_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder, create a new playlist, and add every CONVERTED video to it in folder order. dry_run=true (default) previews the playlist and its videos without creating anything.

tools.name: panda_action_add_folder_videos_to_playlist
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and an existing playlist (by name or ID), then append every CONVERTED folder video to the playlist after its current items. dry_run=true (default) previews the additions.

tools.name: panda_action_apply_profile_to_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a player profile and a folder, list eligible (CONVERTED) videos, and apply the profile to all of them in one call. Free action (no credits). dry_run=true (default) returns a preview of which videos would be updated.

tools.name: panda_action_apply_video_config_to_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and apply per-video player config to every CONVERTED video (POST /player?type=video). Supports: panda_branding, default_subtitle (lang code or 'false'), on_funnel, and the AI toggles questions/mindmap/abstract. Send only the fields you want to change. dry_run=true

tools.name: panda_action_configure_folder_profile
tools.description: Deterministically apply player-profile settings to every CONVERTED video in a folder, taking the correct create-or-update route per video. Covers everything a profile holds: colors (Cores), controls incl. the big play button 'play-large' (Controles / Botão de Play Grande), caption appearance (Legend

tools.name: panda_action_set_folder_player_control
tools.description: Enable or disable a single player control on every CONVERTED video in a folder, via player profiles, PRESERVING all other controls. The big play button (dashboard 'Botão de Play Grande') is the 'play-large' control — disable it with control='play-large', enabled=false. Each video's profile controls

tools.name: panda_action_generate_subtitles_for_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder, list eligible (CONVERTED) videos, estimate the AI subtitle cost in credits, and optionally generate subtitles in one or more languages. Tiers: essential (only en/pt-BR/es, 1 credit/30min), advanced (34 langs, 1 credit/5min), pro (34 langs, 1 credit/min). dry_run=t

tools.name: panda_action_set_default_subtitle_for_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and set the default subtitle language on every CONVERTED video (POST /player?type=video). Pass language 'false' to clear the default. dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos. Note: videos lacking that subtitle simply won't show it.

tools.name: panda_action_remove_subtitle_language_from_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and delete a subtitle language from every CONVERTED video that has it (DELETE /subtitles/{id}). DESTRUCTIVE. dry_run=true (default) previews; set dry_run=false AND confirm=true to delete. Videos without that language are simply skipped by the API.

tools.name: panda_action_dub_folder_videos
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder, list eligible (CONVERTED) videos, estimate the dubbing cost in credits, and optionally create AI dubbing jobs for one or more target languages. dry_run=true (default) returns a preview without creating any job. standard mode = 2 credits/min, lipsync = 10 credits/m

tools.name: panda_action_create_tutor_from_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder, estimate the credit cost via purchase_overview, and create an AI Tutor bound to every CONVERTED video in the folder. dry_run=true (default) returns the cost preview without creating anything.

tools.name: panda_action_add_folder_videos_to_tutor
tools.description: Deterministically resolve an existing AI Tutor (by name or ID) and a folder, then bind every CONVERTED folder video to the tutor (POST /assist_ai/update_assistant_videos). dry_run=true (default) previews the additions.

tools.name: panda_action_enable_ai_package_for_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and activate the AI package (mindmap + abstract/eBook + quiz) for every CONVERTED video (POST /aiworkflow type=ALL_TEXT_ITEMS). Estimates credits (1/started minute; Gold/Enterprise may have a free daily quota that reduces real cost). dry_run=true (default) returns

tools.name: panda_action_folder_ai_status
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and report the aggregate status of all its AI workflow jobs (subtitles, dubbing, AI package) via GET /aiworkflow?folder_id. Read-only — returns counts by status and by type. No dry_run (nothing is mutated).

tools.name: panda_action_generate_shorts_from_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and submit each eligible video (CONVERTED, 5min–5h) for AI Shorts generation (POST /shorts/import-video). Each job consumes Shorts processing. dry_run=true (default) previews eligible videos. DRM-protected videos are rejected by the API and surfaced per-video.

tools.name: panda_action_set_custom_field_for_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and set a custom metadata field (key/value) on every CONVERTED video (POST /videos/{id}?custom_fields). dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos.

tools.name: panda_action_apply_watermark_group_to_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a watermark/DRM group (by name or ID) and a folder, then add the folder to the group so all its videos (current and future) inherit the forensic watermark (PUT /drm/videos/{id} folders.increment). dry_run=true (default) previews.

tools.name: panda_action_create_watermark_group_for_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and create a new watermark/DRM group seeded with all its videos (POST /drm/videos). dry_run=true (default) previews the group and its videos.

tools.name: panda_action_add_folder_videos_to_funnel
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a funnel (by name or ID) and a folder, then add every CONVERTED folder video to the funnel (POST /funnels/add_videos). dry_run=true (default) previews the additions.

tools.name: panda_action_schedule_lives
tools.description: Create one or more scheduled live streams in a single call (POST /lives), optionally recording into a resolved folder. dry_run=true (default) previews the lives that would be created.

tools.name: panda_action_set_anti_download
tools.description: Enable or disable account-wide anti-download protection (GET/PUT /block_download). Reads the current state first and only changes it if needed. dry_run=true (default) previews the change.

tools.name: panda_action_set_allowed_domains
tools.description: Add referer domains to the account's allow/block list for playback (POST /library/{id}?action=refer) and optionally toggle 'block requests with no referer'. Resolves the library ID automatically. dry_run=true (default) previews.

tools.name: panda_action_request_folder_downloads
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and request an async download for every CONVERTED video at a given quality/format/language (POST /download-async/{externalId}). Poll status later with panda_check_download_status. dry_run=true (default) previews the requests.

tools.name: panda_action_export_folder_analytics
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and aggregate per-video play analytics over a date range (GET /general/{videoId} on the analytics host). Read-only — returns a per-video breakdown and folder total. No dry_run.

tools.name: panda_action_create_ab_test
tools.description: Create an A/B comparison from 2+ videos (POST /comparison) and optionally start it immediately (PUT /comparison/{id}?type=start). dry_run=true (default) previews.

tools.name: panda_action_credit_preflight
tools.description: Estimate the credit cost of running a paid operation (dub / subtitles / ai_package) across every CONVERTED video in a folder and compare it to the current balance — WITHOUT executing anything. Read-only; use before the real action to decide whether to proceed.

tools.name: panda_action_transfer_credits_to_subaccount
tools.description: Resolve a subaccount by name or ID and transfer credits to it (POST /user/limit/transfer_credits). Checks the parent balance first. dry_run=true (default) previews the transfer.

tools.name: panda_action_provision_user
tools.description: Create a team user, resolving the role by name (or original_name/ID) to its role_id (POST /users). dry_run=true (default) previews. Validates the email format up front.

tools.name: panda_action_create_review_link_for_folder
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a folder and create a review link for every CONVERTED video (POST /video-review/{id}?action=link). dry_run=true (default) previews the links that would be created.

tools.name: panda_action_set_webhook
tools.description: Idempotently set the account webhook URL. Reads the current webhook (GET /user/webhook); if a different one exists it is removed (DELETE /user/webhook/{id}) before creating the new one (POST /user/webhook). dry_run=true (default) previews the change.

tools.name: panda_action_set_forms_integration
tools.description: Create or update a forms/CRM integration by service name. Reads existing integrations (GET /forms-integration/get); updates in place if the service already exists (PUT /forms-integration/update), otherwise creates it (POST /forms-integration/save). dry_run=true (default) previews.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "panda_update_profile" is 1055 chars, far longer than this server's median (125). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
